title: A deep learning approach for EPID-based patient-specific quality assurance incorporating daily machine-state variations.
summary: A deep-learning model combined electronic portal imaging device data with daily machine-state features to predict gamma pass rates and assess detection under simulated machine and multileaf-collimator deviations. This is an engineering quality-assurance result, not evidence of improved patient outcomes.
ai_technology: Deep-learning prediction using EPID images and daily machine-state features

evidence.tested: Plan-paired tests and simulated deviation scenarios evaluated gamma-pass-rate prediction and deviation detection.
evidence.unknown: The tests do not establish patient-outcome benefit or performance in prospective clinical deployment.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning prediction using EPID images and daily machine-state features

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
